steps.description:
Write a function named show(x) with an input argument x. It will display x on the screen.

Test your function by calling it with the following input arguments: show("Hello world!") show(100) show(5.9)

Follow the test output display format.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Hello world! 100 5.9
steps.answer:
# Create a function named show(x)
def show(x):
    print(x)

# Call the function
show("Hello world!")
show(100)
show(5.9)
